title: ADEPT: Adaptive Monocular Depth Estimation via Model-In-The-Loop Photometric Tuning with Capture Risk Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.27423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Exposure and gain determine the visual evidence available to monocular depth estimation (MDE), particularly when robot motion creates a tradeoff between light collection and motion blur. We present ADEPT, a framework that adapts these settings using learned feedback from a frozen depth model. During training, ground-truth depth identifies the lowest-error reference within a group of physically evaluated camera settings. A compact predictor learns reference-relative disagreement (RRD) between each candidate's depth prediction and the reference prediction using regression and ranking losses. At deployment, it scores observed captures using frozen-model features and camera, motion, and illumination context, without ground truth or reference images. A contextual Gaussian-process controller uses recent scores to select subsequent exposure and gain settings under motion and photometric constraints. We evaluate offline camera selection with r

translated_title: ADEPT：通过模型在环光度调节与采集风险预测实现自适应单目深度估计
translated_abstract: 曝光和增益决定了单目深度估计（MDE）可获取的视觉证据质量，尤其当机器人运动导致光线收集与运动模糊之间存在权衡时更是如此。我们提出了ADEPT，一个利用从冻结深度模型中学习到的反馈来自适应调整这些设置的框架。在训练阶段，真值深度用于在一组经过物理评估的相机设置中识别误差最低的参考设置。一个紧凑的预测器通过回归和排序损失，学习每个候选设置的深度预测与参考预测之间的参考相对分歧（RRD）。在部署阶段，该预测器利用冻结模型特征以及相机、运动和光照上下文信息对实际采集的图像进行评分，无需真值或参考图像。一个上下文高斯过程控制器利用近期评分，在运动和光度约束下选择后续的曝光和增益设置。我们通过离线相机选择方式对……进行评估（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出ADEPT框架，以“模型在环”方式训练一个采集风险预测器，并借助上下文高斯过程控制器自适应调节相机曝光与增益，从而在机器人运动场景下提升单目深度估计的精度。
en_tdlr: ADEPT adaptively tunes camera exposure and gain for monocular depth estimation by learning a capture-risk predictor from a frozen depth model in the loop, with a contextual Gaussian-process controller selecting settings under motion and photometric constraints.
